Name: JerryBB's Outfit Collection
Author: JerryBBS2
Description:
[center][size=5][b][color=#F4A6C0]JerryBB's Outfit Collection[/color][/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#F7D794]Teddy Bear · Bunny · Little Kitten[/color][/size][/center]

[size=3]Three cute hi-res outfits for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url].
Each outfit comes with hair, top, skirt, sleeves and accessories, drawn for all four directions.[/size]

[line]
[size=4][b][color=#FF7FA8]REQUIRED: JerryBB's FS Outfit Framework[/color][/b][/size]
Download it here: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/55346][b]JerryBB's FS Outfit Framework[/b][/url]
[b]The outfits will not load without it.[/b] Install it once, every JerryBB outfit shares it.
[list]
[*][color=#F7D794]Riding[/color] - Keeps the hi-res outfits on the body when you ride a horse, tractor or broom.
[*][color=#F7D794]Sitting[/color] - No more floating clothes on chairs and benches.
[*][color=#F7D794]Map icon[/color] - The hair stays on the map and minimap head icon.
[/list]
[line]
[size=4][b][color=#C9B6F2]Requirements[/color][/b][/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] 4.0.0 or newer
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url] 7.0.0 or newer
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/55346]JerryBB's FS Outfit Framework[/url] ([b]REQUIRED[/b])
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]The outfits are drawn for GH's Peach Tall Body type (female). Other body mods may not line up.[/color]

[size=4][b][color=#C9B6F2]Installation[/color][/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/55346]JerryBB's FS Outfit Framework[/url].
[*]Download JerryBB's Outfit Collection (English or Korean edition).
[*]Unzip both into your Mods folder.
[/list]
[size=4][b][color=#C9B6F2]How to wear[/color][/b][/size]
Open the [b]Hand Mirror[/b]. Hair, Hat, Shirt and Pants are in their own tabs.
Sleeves, the side view arm cover, ribbons, tails, ears and bags are in the [b]Accessory[/b] tab.
Every item name starts with "JerryBB's". See the Parts Guide images.

[size=4][b][color=#C9B6F2]Files[/color][/b][/size]
[list]
[*]All three outfits come in one file.
[*]English and Korean editions. [b]Install only one edition.[/b]
[/list]
[line]
[size=3][b][color=#C9B6F2]AI disclosure[/color][/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]The outfit designs started from AI-generated concept images. I redrew and cleaned the pixels, fixed colours, fitted all four directions and set everything up in game by hand.[/color]

[size=3][b][color=#FF7FA8]Permissions[/color][/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Do not upload translations or re-uploads of this mod without my permission.
Unauthorized translations and re-uploads will be reported.[/color]

[line]
[size=4][b][color=#F4A6C0]Thank you[/color][/b][/size]
[color=#F7D794]Big thanks to every creator who made this possible:[/color]
[list]
[*][b]ConcernedApe[/b] for Stardew Valley.
[*][b]Pathoschild[/b] for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
[*][b]PeacefulEnd[/b] for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url]. These outfits could not exist without it.
[*][b]spacechase0[/b] for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].
[*][b]GH[/b] for GH's Peach Tall Body type, the beautiful body these outfits are drawn on.
[*][b]Bouhm[/b] for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/239]NPC Map Locations[/url], which helped me test the minimap head icon.
[/list][center][color=#F4A6C0]Thank you for downloading, and have fun dressing up! - JerryBB[/color][/center]
